topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can scarce believe my own eyes, nor the words what came from his mouth. There he stood, my friend since but a lad, who knew every turn of my soul and the secret tracks we'd run as children. He spoke to me as though I were a stranger met on the road, his face blank as the winter sky before the first snow. I told him of the days we fished the river, of the time we hid from the overseer, but his eyes stayed cold, not a flicker of remembrance. It’s as if the years I held dear have been swept away like chaff in the wind. How can it be that he’s lost the heart of our friendship?
